mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.resource, p.action, p.description, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM `permission` p INNER JOIN `role_permission` rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN `role` r ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN `user_role` ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.code, p.resource, p.action, p.description, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM `permission` p INNER JOIN `role_permission` rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1
SELECT id, name, code, resource, action, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM `permission` WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 1
